newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Five killed, three wounded in southern Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Five killed, three wounded in southern Philippines.

text.p: Five suspected members of a Moslem group fighting for autonomy in the southern Philippine islands were shot dead in a clash with the military, officials said on Saturday.

Three soldiers were also wounded in the gunbattle between the military and 20 members of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) in a remote area on Basilan island on Wednesday, Southern Command military spokesman Fredesvindo Covarrubias told reporters.
Covarrubias said the military stationed on Basilan island, 900 km (562 miles) south of Manila, clashed with the MILF members after shots were fired near a school.

Minor clashes between MILF members and the military in recent weeks have not affected a peace accord signed last month between the mainstream Moslem guerilla group Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the government.

President Fidel Ramos signed last month a peace deal with MNLF chief Nur Misuari, ending a 24-year separatist war by the MNLF. The government said it has also started contacts with the MILF, a breakaway faction demanding an Islamic state, in an attempt to conclude a separate deal with them.
